parts.text: Explain the following terms as applied in chemistry
Explain why the nucleus is assumed to contain virtually all the mass of an atom.
Rutherford atomic model was one of the earliest theories of atomic structure. Explain any two major conclusions of his theory.
Briefly explain the following rules/principles concerning electronic configuration
Using the s, p, d notation, write down the electronic configuration for the following atoms (Refer to the Periodic table attached for atomic numbers)
Calculate the effective nuclear charge for the outermost electron in a copper atom.
Calculate the pH of 0.1M solution of hydrochloric acid.
Balance the following redox reaction. MnO4-(aq) + Br-(aq) Mn2+ + Br2(aq) (aq)

items.text: 2. a) Explain why the ionic radius of anions are generally higher than those of cations. b) State and explain the trend of the following parameters across a period of the periodic table (Periodic trend) i) Atomic radii ii) Ionization energy iii) Electron affinity c) Explain the term `Electronegativity' d) The 1st, 2nd, 3rdand 4th ionization energies of aluminium ere 577, 1815, 2740 and 11590kJ/mol. Calculate the effective nuclear charge of the outermost electron being removed in each of the successive ionizations and use it to explain the variation (trend) in the successive ionization energies. Explain also why 4th ionization energy is extra ordinarily high

M counter to drop from 4800 counts per minute to 300 counts per minute. c) Draw the lewis structures of the following compounds i) NH3 iii) CO32- d) Suggest the structures of the following compounds i) CH4 ii) C2H4
